description.value: Donair Affair is a BC restaurant chain with over 20 locations and nearly 25 years of history, specializing in Mediterranean-inspired donair kebabs made with fresh ingredients and a choice of beef, lamb, chicken, or falafel. The Port Coquitlam location on Mary Hill Road serves wraps, Mayan platters, and combo specials in a casual, wheelchair-accessible setting. Touring cyclists will find quick, filling meals including vegetarian and vegan-friendly falafel options with a variety of sauces and toppings.
